DIAGNOSIS READY: Ectopic Pregnancy.

The clinical presentation of vaginal bleeding, unilateral abdominal pain, and a specific ultrasound finding (likely an empty or non-viable intrauterine sac or adnexal mass) in a pregnant patient is highly suggestive of an ectopic pregnancy. This is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate surgical or medical intervention to prevent rupture and hemorrhage.
